item.title: Headstart Makes Rust Compile 2x Faster? I Pinned It Down on a 2-Core Machine
item.description: PowderworksCode/headstart patches rustc to ship rmeta early — up to 54% faster cargo check on 16 cores. I applied the patches to a self-built toolchain and ran the switch on/off A/B on a 2-core EPYC slice against topcoat (143 crates): check gains drop to 5.7%, build to 3.2%. The 'up to 2x' core-count decay curve, proven at its lowest point.
